Theme

Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

disagree verb

also I disagree, I strongly disagree with you, difference of opinion, disagreement

classical

Cic. de Or. 1.5: solēs nōn numquam hāc dē rē ā mē in disputātiōnibus nostrīs dissentīre (Lewis & Short)
Traupman 304

dissentiō, dissentīre, dissēnsī, dissēnsum

verb, fourth conjugation; with ab + ablative of the person

disagree, differ in opinion

Other words

  • dissēnsiō, dissēnsiōnis f. — disagreement, difference of opinion

    noun, third declension · also used · classical · Cic. de Or. 1.238: inter hominēs dē jūre (Lewis & Short); Traupman 303

Examples

  • Vehementer ā tē dissentiō.

    I strongly disagree with you.Traupman 304

See also conflict, strongly, opinion.

SourcesLewis & Short: dissentio

Lewis & Short: dissensio

Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
